description: Write the portal's import CSV from questions people actually asked, most frequent first, instead of guessing from the workspace. onlyFailed (default true) keeps the sessions that escalated, went unanswered or were abandoned, which are the ones worth turning into regression cases. Read-only apart from writing the file; import it once in the portal, then cs_run_evaluation automates the runs.

botId.description: Agent (bot) id. Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_AGENT_ID.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

days.description: Only sessions from the last N days

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

maxCases.description: Maximum cases in the CSV (portal limit is 100)

onlyFailed.description: Default true: only sessions that escalated, went unresolved or were abandoned

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_test_set_from_transcripts
title: Build an evaluation test set from real conversations
